full_judgment: 2. Respondent Nos. 1-4 of C.A. No. 228 and respondent Nos. 1 and 2 of C.A. No. 229 of 2015 as the petitioners respectively filed Writ Petition Nos. 17056 and 17216 of 2012 before the High Court Division challenging Memo No. B.R.Dhaka 98/98/799 dated 02-0.2012, both issued by writ respondent No. 4, Manager Court of Wards, Bhawal Raj Estate, Dhaka requesting respondent No. 5, the District Registrar Dhaka not to register any deed of transfer/sale of any property of C.S. plot Nos. 2497 and 2582 of C.S. Khatian No. 118 of Mouza 13aunia J.L. No. 211 as found at page 510 of projabili property Gazette (Annexure G to the writ petition) corresponding to S.A. Khatian Nos. 118 /41, 118/76, 183, 184, 188, 198, 212, 220, 1747, 179, 118/2, and 234 corresponding to R.S. plot Nos. 6108, 6109, 6110, 6112 and 6116 of R.S. Khatian Nos. 63, 116, 117, 181, 240, 811, 818, 819, 962, 1083, 1371, 1490 and 1589 and C.S. Plot Nos. 2035, 2106, 2137, 2142, 2161, 2176, 2972, 2976, 2977, 2987, 3280, 3290 and 2977/3459 recorded in C.S. Khatian Nos. 554, 555 and C.S. plot Nos. 2748 and 2970 of C.S. Khatian Nos. 118, C.S. Plot Nos. 3280/3438 of C.S. Khatian No. 646. and C.S. Plot No. 3279 of C.S. Khatian Nos. 12 of Mouza Baunia of J.L. No. 211 along with some other properties of other plots of the aforesaid Khatians corresponding to as many as 66 R.S. Plots respectly (plots are not mentioned as those would not be necessary in disposing the appeals) to have been issued without lawful authority and were of no legal effect and accordingly the Rule Nisi was issud in the respective writ petition.
